name: Haystack Cookies
description: No-bake chocolate peanut butter oatmeal cookies, boiled briefly on the stove and dropped by spoonfuls to set.
keywords: no-bake cookies, oatmeal, chocolate, peanut butter

recipeInstructions.name: Cook the base
recipeInstructions.text: Cook 2 cups sugar, 1/2 cup milk, 1 stick butter and 4 tbsp cocoa together for 1 1/2 minutes. After it boils, remove from the heat.

recipeInstructions.name: Stir in the rest
recipeInstructions.text: Quickly add 1/2 cup peanut butter, 2 1/2 cups oatmeal and 2 tsp vanilla.

recipeInstructions.name: Shape and cool
recipeInstructions.text: Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let cool.
